workflow.staff_inputs: Queue entries, cleaning and service actions, correction and outcome are explicit test inputs.
checks: End of clip disables seating recommendations
Playback restart creates a fresh session and pause freezes the scenario clock
Staff confirmation gates readiness and occupied table cleaning is rejected
Staff roster, policy, assumptions and role-checked service task lifecycle
Queue capacity, stale approval rejection, availability and read-only what-if
Manager correction retained in local Hindsight and duplicate capture deduplicated
Logical shift preserves floor and queue; local handover recalls cited correction
Cited Local memory changes T1 baseline to T4; staff approval seats the party exactly once
Outcome is recorded separately from approval
Camera departure opens cleaning work, handover shows it, and staff completion restores readiness
Cleaned table reseats the next party and analytics and CSV agree
Final playback paused on the real occupied scene; local outbox fully delivered

memory_advice.summary: Seat the waiting party at table T4, following the manager’s correction that during a delivery rush the front table T4 is preferred over the noisy rear booth T1.
